vision.title: Vision & Mission
vision.vision_text: Prepare knowledgeable, pioneering, contemporary and globally minded generations who are capable to innovate, create and compete.
vision.mission_text: Baraem Al Ain Private School, through its qualified educational staff, and in partnership with parents and the local community, seeks to provide effective institutional performance that ensures the quality of learning outcomes according to the highest national and international standards, and qualifies a generation that possesses knowledge, skills and values, belongs to the United Arab Emirates, and assumes their social responsibilities in a developing and changing world.

requirements.title: Requirements
requirements.intro: We are pleased to welcome you to Baraem Al Ain Schools / Al Ain branch and invite you to register for the new school year. We provide a distinguished learning environment that develops students’ abilities through the Ministry or American curriculum, qualified teachers, and modern facilities.
requirements.docs_title: To complete registration successfully, please provide the following documents:
requirements.doc_1: Valid Emirates ID for the student.
requirements.doc_3: Student birth certificate and vaccination certificate.
requirements.doc_6: If the student comes from outside the country, the certificate must be attested with grade details attached.
requirements.note_siblings: Please note that priority is given to siblings. Kindly ensure siblings’ full tuition fees are settled before registering a new student.
requirements.note_interview: A personal interview is a mandatory admission requirement. Our team will schedule the interview with the student and guardian after receiving the required documents.
requirements.note_bring: Please bring all required documents when applying to ensure a fast and smooth registration process.
requirements.closing: We look forward to welcoming your children and working together for the best learning experience.

aboutSchool.title: About the School
aboutSchool.heading: Baraem Al Ain Private School
aboutSchool.body_1: Founded in 1982, Baraem Al Ain Private School pursues its vision of preparing educated, innovative generations capable of creating, innovating, and competing in all fields.
aboutSchool.body_2: Our administrative and teaching staff is a distinguished group of qualified administrators and teachers who support students in their learning journey and skill development.
aboutSchool.body_3: The school provides a learning environment that stimulates critical thinking and collaboration, with modern classrooms, a comprehensive library, advanced science labs, a grass sports field, and an innovation center, equipping students with the knowledge and values to serve their community.
aboutSchool.body_4: Baraem Al Ain Private School in Al Ain is co-educational (boys and girls in separate sections), offering the Ministry curriculum from Grade 1 to Grade 12 and the American curriculum from KG1 to Grade 8.

principalWord.title: Principal’s Word
principalWord.heading: School Principal Dr. Hussein Abu Artaima
principalWord.body_1: I am pleased to welcome you to Baraem Al Ain Private School - Al Ain branch, a leading educational institution in the United Arab Emirates.
principalWord.body_2: We work sincerely to realize our vision of preparing knowledgeable, pioneering generations capable of innovation and creativity. Our deep belief that education is the cornerstone of a strong, prosperous society drives us to provide an integrated learning environment that develops students’ skills and inspires creativity.
principalWord.body_3: At Baraem Al Ain we motivate students to explore their potential and leadership spirit to achieve their future academic and career ambitions. We believe a successful student is a creative, innovative one, so we offer advanced curricula supporting critical thinking and innovation, backed by a distinguished staff committed to the highest quality standards.
principalWord.body_4: We are confident that cooperation between the school and parents is key to advancing education, and we are glad to be an effective partner in raising our children to become tomorrow’s leaders and innovators.
principalWord.body_5: Thank you for your trust in Baraem Al Ain Private School. Together we build a bright future for our children.

nationalId.title: National Identity
nationalId.intro: Baraem Al Ain Schools embody their vision of instilling national identity values in students, inspired by the UAE National Agenda 2021 and the “We the UAE 2031” vision of strengthening cultural identity and belonging, making the UAE a global model of leadership and innovation.
nationalId.arabic_body: The school attaches great importance to Arabic as a cornerstone for understanding the country’s culture, history, and identity, supporting both native and non-native speakers through modern technology and effective strategies.
nationalId.history_body: The school fosters students’ understanding of UAE history and national identity, highlighting the role of the UAE’s leaders and the late Sheikh Zayed bin Sultan Al Nahyan in founding the Union.
nationalId.heritage_body: The school revives and preserves Emirati heritage through arts, literature, and music, helping students understand customs, traditions, and cultural heritage, and respect for the flag and national anthem.
nationalId.respect_body: The school promotes respect as the basis of positive behavior and sound human relations, developing effective communication skills including dialogue ethics, listening, and tact.
nationalId.compassion_body: The school fosters a culture of compassion so every student feels valued and understood, integrating compassion into teaching and encouraging sharing, cooperation, and charity.
nationalId.global_body: The school enables students to understand and appreciate the UAE’s multicultural environment while holding to their national identity, practicing global understanding and positive interaction with other cultures.
nationalId.belonging_body: The school strengthens belonging and social solidarity among students, staff, and parents through innovative programs, instilling unity inspired by Sheikh Zayed’s vision and legacy.
nationalId.volunteering_body: The school instills a culture of volunteering as a means of responsibility and belonging, inspired by Sheikh Zayed’s vision that established volunteering as a core community value.
nationalId.conservation_body: The school raises students’ awareness of environmental conservation and sustainability as a core social responsibility, inspired by Sheikh Zayed’s legacy of caring for the environment.

gifted.title: Our Talents
gifted.intro: The “Our Talents” program is a series highlighting our creative students’ talents across fields, celebrating their achievements and motivating them to keep shining.

reading.title: Reading Challenge
reading.body_about: The Arab Reading Challenge is the largest Arab project launched by H.H. Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum to encourage reading, with over a million students reading fifty million books each school year.
reading.body_purpose: This guide targets the whole school community (students, teachers, parents) to explain the competition, raise awareness of reading’s role in developing minds, and prepare a generation able to face challenges with knowledge.
reading.body_date: The competition runs in Arabic from Grade 1 to Grade 12, from September each year to the end of March, across five stages of ten books each summarized in challenge passports.
reading.body_stages: Registration passes through 6 stages: enrollment via the school, then the red, green, blue, silver, and gold passports, reading and summarizing ten books per stage up to fifty books per year.
reading.body_steps: Registration steps: contact the school challenge supervisor Mr. Elsayed Elsamnoudi, complete the application, fill in your passport details, read and summarize the books, and move to the next passport after every ten books.
reading.body_conditions: Participants must be Grade 1 to Grade 12 students enrolled in an Arab school, apply between September and April, and complete five stages of ten summarized books in challenge passports.
reading.body_bookConditions: Books must be in Arabic or translated into Arabic, age-appropriate, cultural (arts, literature, science, history, politics, general culture, stories, or novels), and not reference works, magazines, newspapers, or curriculum books.
reading.body_howToWin: To win: strong language and summarizing skills, critical thinking and reading commitment, general knowledge, and the language skills needed to read books translated into Arabic.
reading.body_suggested: The organizers set suggested books by age group, including diverse stories, novels, and cultural books.
reading.body_contact: Contact the competition supervisor Mr. Elsayed Elsamnoudi by phone or email, and register via the form below.
reading.body_mechanism: Students register through their schools, progress through the colored passports up to gold by completing fifty books, then oral and written qualifiers lead to the Dubai finals.
reading.body_judging: Judging criteria: correct Arabic, reading comprehension and answer accuracy, book type and age suitability, and the student’s general cultural level.
reading.body_faq: Frequently asked questions about self-introduction, book types, page counts, required summaries, and judging.
reading.body_links: Useful files and links including participant guides, judging criteria and forms, and challenge passports in docx and pdf.

lms.title: LMS Platform
lms.intro: The smart learning gateway launched by the UAE Ministry of Education, connecting teachers, students, and parents for Ministry-curriculum students.

mcgraw.title: McGraw Hill Platform
mcgraw.intro: A platform for American-curriculum students. In partnership with McGraw Hill, a global leader in high-quality curricula that build academic skills and critical, creative thinking.
mcgraw.body: Dear parents, as part of our commitment to the best curricula, we are pleased to partner with McGraw Hill, a global leader in high-quality curricula that build students’ abilities and critical, creative thinking. McGraw Hill offers innovative solutions across academic subjects aligned with international standards — we invite you to follow your children’s progress and use the available resources.

madrasa.title: Madrasa Platform
madrasa.intro: Madrasa is a free e-learning initiative by the Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum Global Initiatives, offering high-quality interactive Arabic content.
madrasa.feat_1: Rich educational content: thousands of videos and lessons covering all stages from kindergarten to secondary school.
madrasa.feat_2: Free to use: anyone can access the content for free, helping narrow the education gap in the Arab world.
madrasa.feat_3: Interactive quality: lessons are designed interactively to boost understanding and make subjects easy to grasp.
madrasa.feat_4: Arabic focus: promotes learning in Arabic with high-quality content aligned with Arab curricula.
madrasa.feat_5: Anytime, anywhere access: students, parents, and teachers can reach lessons online at any time.
madrasa.outro: This platform is an important step toward improving education quality in the Arab world and making knowledge accessible to all.

matific.title: Matific Platform
matific.intro: Matific is a digital platform teaching mathematics from kindergarten to Grade 6 through interactive activities and games that make learning math fun and effective.

qubits.title: Qubits Platform
qubits.intro: Qubits brings AI-powered computer science learning to Baraem Al Ain students with a flexible curriculum. For KG2 to Grade 8 (American section).
qubits.note: For KG2 to Grade 8 students (American section).

ich.title: ICH Platform
ich.intro: Created by the Department of Culture and Tourism - Abu Dhabi, this interactive platform explores the UAE’s intangible cultural heritage. For all school students.

khan.title: Khan Academy Platform
khan.intro: We offer a unique learning experience through Khan Academy, covering mathematics, science, history, and English with interactive lessons and progress reports. Used in both curricula.
khan.note: Offered in both the Ministry and American curricula.

classdojo.title: ClassDojo Platform
classdojo.intro: We use ClassDojo as an effective communication tool between school and parents to follow performance, behavior, homework, and announcements, and to reinforce positive behavior with points.

kutubee.title: Kutubee Platform
kutubee.intro: An interactive platform developing Arabic and English reading skills with 1600+ graded stories approved by the UAE Ministry of Education. For KG1 to Grade 8.

tinkercad.title: TinkerCAD Platform
tinkercad.intro: TinkerCAD is a web tool simplifying 3D design, electronic circuits, and programming with an easy drag-and-drop interface and Arduino block or text coding.
tinkercad.body: TinkerCAD also supports circuit programming via Arduino using blocks or text code, making electronic programming easy even for beginners — a powerful tool for learning electronics, programming, and smart-system control basics.
